title: Report: How AI is reshaping the entire beauty value chain
summary: From product formulation to the point of sale, artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming the beauty industry and reshaping brand strategies. To assess the scale of this shift and anticipate its implications, Pascale Brousse, founder of Trendsourcing, and Hugo Willemin, analyst and futurist, have conducted an international foresight study examining AI's impact on the cosmetics industry and the challenges it presents for the future. title: MZPACK puts decoration and biomaterials at the heart of packaging innovation
summary: The Chinese packaging manufacturer combines advanced moulding and decoration capabilities with an expanding portfolio of alternative materials, including PHA, to help beauty brands create distinctive packaging while exploring more sustainable solutions. MZPACK recently showcased its expertise at Cosmopack Asia in Hong Kong. title: Petcare: A new frontier for the beauty industry?
summary: Skincare, dietary supplements, fragrances, spa-inspired treatments — the petcare market is undergoing a transformation as pets take on an increasingly important role in people's lives. While brands are rolling out a growing range of dedicated product lines, this emerging market also presents challenges for manufacturers, who must adapt their expertise. title: Pure Trade manufactures a metal case for the new Diesel women's fragrance
summary: Designed by Bureau Tonalli for L'Oréal, this oval tinplate case holds the bottle of Only Desire, the new diesel women's fragrance together with a scented body product. According to Pure Trade, from an industrial point of view, everything rests on the fully rounded contours and on the embossed graphics of the lid, which push the drawing of the metal to its limits in an exact balance between mechanical strength and formability. title: Smelody brings music into the perfume bottle with a patented sound device
summary: The Grasse-based start-up combines eight fragrances with classical music pieces, played automatically when the bottle is opened through a patented sound device built into the cap. This packaging innovation puts the multisensory experience at the heart of the product. What if a perfume bottle could also play music? This is the concept developed by Smelody, a young company founded in September 2025 in Grasse by Frederick Besson, also the creator of the Perfumist app. Launched in October 2026... - Innovation & new products

title: Flosty launches IRIS, a French-made thick-wall Surlyn fragrance cap
summary: As niche fragrance brands continue to expand their portfolios, demand for distinctive packaging components that help products stand out on the shelf is growing. To address this need, prestige standard packaging supplier Flosty has introduced IRIS, a new fragrance cap made from Surlyn resin. Designed to deliver the optical clarity of glass without its fragility, the thick-wall cap is available for immediate development and customization. title: Medicos Beauty puts its colour expertise on display in a 200 ml Carita jar
summary: Medicos Beauty designed and manufactured the 200 ml jar for Maison Carita's restructuring hair mask, meeting the technical challenge of harmonising a deep-black shade, mass-tinted across all three components, though made from different materials, without resorting to carbon black. The cap, in PP, features a bespoke Carita engraving cut directly into the tooling. summary: ACT Beauty has designed and manufactured for Nuxe a sculpting Gua Sha combined with a roller ball. title: L'Oréal to invest nearly EUR 300 million to boost French operations by 2029
summary: L'Oréal plans to invest nearly EUR 300 million in France between 2027 and 2029, the French cosmetics giant announced on Friday, November 20. Environment and R&D The investments are intended to "support the environmental transition" of the group's sites, "strengthen its research and innovation capabilities," and "support the development of its activities," the owner of brands such as Garnier, Maybelline, and Lancôme said in a press release.
